rows.label: World of Warcraft
rows.hook: lets millions explore a fantasy realm online as orcs, elves and humans, the biggest subscription MMO

rows.label: Fortnite
rows.description: 2017 video game developed by Epic Games
rows.hook: drops 100 players onto an island to build forts and be the last one standing, with a hugely popular free mode

rows.label: Free Fire
rows.hook: is a mobile battle royale with short matches that runs well on low-end phones and is hugely popular worldwide

rows.label: League of Legends
rows.description: 2009 multiplayer online battle arena video game
rows.hook: pits two teams of five champions against each other to destroy the enemy base, filling arenas for its finals

rows.label: Counter-Strike 2
rows.hook: is the latest of the legendary team shooters where one side plants a bomb and the other defuses it

rows.label: Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos
rows.hook: is a fantasy real-time strategy game where hero units lead armies, and it spawned a huge custom-map scene

rows.label: Street Fighter II
rows.hook: is the arcade classic that launched the one-on-one tournament craze, with Ryu, Chun-Li and a hadouken fireball

rows.label: Valorant
rows.description: 2020 free-to-play multiplayer first-person shooter video game developed by Riot Games
rows.hook: is a tactical five-versus-five shooter where agents with special abilities plant or defuse a spike

rows.label: FIFA
rows.hook: is the best-selling annual soccer video game series, famous for Ultimate Team card packs

rows.label: Street Fighter 6
rows.hook: is a modern one-on-one brawler with a Drive gauge and a World Tour mode where you create your own avatar

rows.label: Dota 2
rows.hook: is a five-a-side team game of defending ancient bases, famed for esports prize pools in the millions

rows.label: StarCraft II
rows.hook: is a sci-fi real-time strategy game where Terran, Zerg and Protoss clash, huge in South Korea

rows.label: Brawl Stars
rows.hook: is a fast mobile game of short three-versus-three matches with a cast of quirky playable characters

rows.label: Super Smash Bros. Melee
rows.description: crossover fighting video game developed by Nintendo for the Nintendo GameCube in 2001
rows.hook: is a GameCube brawler with Mario and Link, beloved by competitive players for fast techniques like wavedashing

rows.label: Rocket League
rows.hook: mixes soccer with jet-powered cars that boost into a giant ball to score goals

rows.label: Escape from Tarkov
rows.description: 2017 first-person shooter game developed by Battlestate Games

rows.label: Injustice: Gods Among Us
rows.hook: is a fighting game where DC superheroes like Batman and Superman battle on stage-hazard arenas

rows.label: Overwatch
rows.hook: is a colorful team shooter where two sides of heroes with unique abilities fight over objectives

rows.label: Heroes of the Storm
rows.description: multiplayer video game by Blizzard Entertainment
rows.hook: is a team brawler mashing together famous characters from many fantasy and sci-fi worlds

rows.label: Honor of Kings
rows.hook: is a mobile team battle game with legendary Chinese figures that is among the most-played in the world
